title: Context and Tenancy namespaces, TenantMode and ModelIdentity split
summary: Request-context and tenant-isolation types live in their core namespaces (`Context`, `Context\Internal`, `Tenancy`, `Tenancy\Internal`, `Contracts\Tenancy`), `TenantPolicy::mode()` returns the closed `TenantMode`, `ModelIdentity` is split into `TenantIdentity`/`ContextIdentity` with keys via `Support\ModelKey`, and Filament reads the current scope through `PanelAccess::scope()`.
why: The mixed `Scopes` namespace hides that context and tenancy are core (D7); later scope items need `Context\AssignmentScopePhase/Runtime` at their final FQCN and Filament must stop importing the mutable `CurrentContext` store (architecture#spi-catalog neutral contracts). Hard risk: Fiber/panel locality of the ambient scope (CurrentContext, WithinContext) must survive the move unchanged (I14).

include: Type-map rows (current → target): `Scopes\AssignmentScopePhase` → `Context\AssignmentScopePhase` (Api, @closed, since 0.7); `Scopes\AssignmentScopeRuntime` → `Context\AssignmentScopeRuntime` (Spi(Call)); `Scopes\CurrentContext` → `Context\Internal\CurrentContext`; `Scopes\WithinContext` → `Context\Internal\WithinContext`; `Scopes\TenantPolicy` → `Tenancy\TenantPolicy` (Api); `Scopes\ModelTenantDefinition` → `Tenancy\ModelTenantDefinition` (Api); `Contracts\Scopes\TenantDirectory|TenantMembership|TenantResolver` → `Contracts\Tenancy\…` (Spi(Implement)); `Scopes\ModelIdentity` → `Tenancy\Internal\TenantIdentity` + `Context\Internal\ContextIdentity` (key() callers use `Support\ModelKey`)
New `Tenancy\TenantMode` enum (knowledge/contracts#tenancy); `TenantPolicy::mode(): TenantMode`, factories unchanged; every string-mode comparison in core and Filament uses the enum
All callers in packages/core, packages/filament, tests, bench, stubs and docs updated to the new FQCNs
Manifest regenerated; migration lines for every moved supported FQCN and `TenantPolicy::mode()` return type

No class_alias for old names (D16); V1 proves no old FQCN remains in code.
